title: Admit the v2 Current in the Worker and the tool
acceptance: validateRiseCurrent, currentJsonSchema and the tool guide accept the new fields; every id is checked against the published catalogue; unknown ids are refused with a copyable message.
The curator context is served to the host as an MCP resource (ids, titles, lengths; no payloads).
FND-006 guards stay green; a v1 Current still admits unchanged.

evidence.note: The score, speech and service roadmap; Record.
Validator, lowering, live event path, tool schema and guide; one card browser test per look.

Live release: https://rise.syberlabs.io/release.txt read 3b43a3be on 2026-10-09, after main CI run 37876662647 (CI and production succeeded). It contains #504 (343f2c91, the look) and #517 (3ad74f18, rise.current.v2 with a sound per beat).
Merged as 3ad74f18: a v2 beat may name a sound, checked against SOUND_IDS (BEAT_SOUND refusal); a v1 Current still admits. Since #558 (337da6b7) the eleven Feelings ids are refused.

activity.summary: A Current names one of the ten looks (#504)
Reconciled: the look (#504) is live in release 3b43a3be, delivery deployed; collection, pace and the curator-context resource remain unmet

summary: A Current names one of the ten looks (RISE_CURRENT_LOOKS); the Worker admits the id only, and the card lowers it through its own field, typeface, size and theme (src/core/current-look.js), sound not lowered, Inlay without its word mask. The tool schema and the guide offer the ten. Witnessed in ChatGPT in the final pass.
blocker: Not met: criterion 1 for the stage 1b fields (a per-segment collection and pace are not admitted; only look, and a sound per v2 beat, are); criterion 2 (the curator context is not served as an MCP resource: resources/list offers ui://rise/current and the ui://rise/guide/<style> guides only). Criterion 3 met as far as tests show (v1 still admits).
